facebook.caption: Tourists keep walking past this one. Bè Nắng is a floating seafood restaurant sitting right on the water in Phu Quoc, and locals are rating it 4.7 stars for a reason. Fresh catch pulled straight from the sea, eaten on a raft with nothing but open water around you. Meals run $15-30 per person. That's whole grilled fish and cold beer with a view that costs ten times more at the resort strip. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Stepping onto a floating raft in Phu Quoc to eat the freshest seafood on the island. Bè Nắng delivers the real local dining experience, $15-30 a person, 4.7 stars. Your resort restaurant can't compete with this.

instagram.caption: Locals don't post about Bè Nắng. Floating seafood raft, 4.7 stars, $15-30 a head. This is the one. Save it.
instagram.video_caption: Fresh seafood on a floating raft in Phu Quoc. Bè Nắng hits different when the water's right under your feet.
